subject: Ryan Cason — the reading record
note: Source of truth for /profile's shelf band. The page derives every number from this file — nothing is hand-typed into the HTML — so the count on a public page cannot drift from the actual log. Same discipline as claims.json: if the number is on the site, something has to be able to check it.

_schema.shelf: The influences. Curated and ordered — the ones that changed how I build, not everything I finished. `why` is the whole point: what it changed, not what the book is about. Two sentences. Entries here should also appear in `log`.
_schema.log: Every title finished. `finished` (ISO date) is optional and currently absent — the count does not depend on it. Add dates going forward and the page can start showing how long since a NEW title landed.
_schema.revisiting: Titles with a re-listen currently in progress. These are second or third passes, NOT unfinished books — every title in this file is finished. `remainingMinutes` is what's left on the current pass.
_schema._deliberatelyNoGoal: There is no annual target and no pace bar. A made-up number would be exactly the kind of unbacked figure rule 06 exists to keep off this site.
_schema._allReadTwice: Every title below has been through at least twice. Stated by the subject 2026-07-26; it is why `revisiting` exists as its own bucket instead of being mislabeled 'in progress'.
